status: Rejected: small task allocation saving with consistent private/room throughput loss; full parity unmet
hypothesis: Group independent Quinn connection drivers on one FuturesUnordered worker per actual application-runtime worker, reducing individual Tokio task overhead and coalescing parent scheduling while preserving individual child wakers. Endpoint ingress still uses its independent runtime.
implementation: Add Runtime::spawn_connection with default spawn delegation, and use it only for Connecting connection drivers.
DriverRuntime delegates timers/socket registration/endpoint spawning to TokioRuntime and dispatches connection futures round robin to application worker groups.
Admission uses channels only for newly created drivers; packet/event processing remains in existing Quinn engine. No new traffic, queue-depth or byte cap.
IsolatedDriver catches both polling and destructor panics. Pool ownership cancellation aborts workers and drops parked children.
Synchronous ingress bind outside an application runtime retains ordinary driver spawning. A retired worker falls back to ordinary spawning rather than dropping a future.

Mixed profile exposes FuturesUnordered ArcWake work (1.43% self versus 1.00% Tokio wake_by_val at baseline); private diagnostic reproduced the capacity loss. Profiles do not prove a complete causal explanation for the regression.

import sys,json,argparse,subprocess,os
from pathlib import Path
root=Path.cwd();out=root/'artifacts/webtransport';sys.path.insert(0,str(root/'scripts'))
import inspection
original=subprocess.Popen;client=[None];roles={}
def popen(cmd,*a,**kw):
 if cmd[0]=='perf':
  cmd=list(cmd);index=cmd.index('-p');roles['server']=int(cmd[index+1]);roles['client']=client[0]
  assert roles['client'];cmd[index+1]+=','+str(roles['client']);cmd[cmd.index('-e')+1]='cycles';cmd[cmd.index('-F')+1]='249';cmd+=['-m','512'];cmd=['sudo','-n']+cmd
 p=original(cmd,*a,**kw)
 if any(Path(str(x)).name=='inspection' for x in cmd):client[0]=p.pid
 return p
subprocess.Popen=popen
for v in ['handshake-spans','grouped-drivers']:
 client[0]=None;roles.clear()
 source=out/'owner-poll-private-owner-poll-1.json';a=json.loads(source.read_text())['args'];a.update(server=str(out/f'binaries/{v}-relay'),profile=True,seconds=8,output=str(out/f'grouped-drivers-private-reliable-mixed-{v}-profile.json'))
 for k in ['server','client','client_source_root','tls_front','tls_cert','tls_key','tls_ca','heap_profile','heap_library','output','fanout_latency_output']:
  if a.get(k) is not None:a[k]=Path(a[k])
 r=inspection.run(argparse.Namespace(**a));assert r['passed'];data=a['output'].with_suffix('.perf.data')
 for role,pid in roles.items():
  text=subprocess.run(['sudo','-n','perf','report','--stdio','--no-children','-g','none','--pid',str(pid),'--sort','dso,symbol','--percentage','relative','--percent-limit','0.3','-i',str(data)],capture_output=True,text=True,check=True).stdout
  assert 'Total Lost Samples: 0' in text
  (out/f'grouped-drivers-private-reliable-{v}-{role}-symbols.txt').write_text(text)
 (out/f'grouped-drivers-private-reliable-{v}-profile-roles.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(roles),indent=2))
 subprocess.run(['sudo','-n','chown',f'{os.getuid()}:{os.getgid()}',str(data)],check=True)
 print('DONE',v,roles,flush=True)
